content: The project is envisioned as a modern rental apartment model, optimizing spatial efficiency while ensuring comfort, functionality, and a high quality of living. The design focuses on maximizing natural light, enhancing ventilation, and creating flexible spatial arrangements, providing a comfortable living environment for residents while improving investment efficiency for the owner.
